# Markdown import example

You can paste Markdown or import a `.md` file into Hoora Docs.

## Formatting

**Bold**, _italic_, [links](https://release.hoora.in), and `inline code` are supported.

| Content       | How it works                  |
| ------------- | ----------------------------- |
| Markdown      | Write or import, then preview |
| HTML artifact | Upload a standalone file      |

1. Prepare a private draft.
2. Review the preview.
3. Publish when ready.

> Draft edits stay private until published.

```javascript
console.log('Hello, Hoora');
```
